newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to look again at Korean microwave dumping.
newsitem.headline: EU to look again at Korean microwave dumping.

text.p: The European Commission is to re-examine anti-dumping measures on imports of microwave ovens from South Korea after complaints from European manufacturers that they have had no effect.

A notice in the European Commission's Official Journal available on Tuesday said a group of EU manufacturers formally complained on December 5 that anti-dumping duties on Korean microwave ovens had "led to no movement, or insufficient movement, in resale prices or subsequent selling prices in the community".
The Official Journal said manufacturers alleged that Korean manufacturers had absorbed the cost of previous anti-dumping duties and in many cases prices of imported products had dropped.
It said interested parties had 37 days to declare an interest in the new investigation. -- David Fox, Brussels newsroom ++ 32 2 287 6832
